items.title: Henry "Pickle" Jackson Interview, 1961-08-09
items.q: I never really knew his real first name, but they used to call him Black Benny.

ctx.x: Do you remember some of the drummers that were in those bands? Well, they had a drummer they used to call Benny.
I never really knew his real first name, but they used to call him Black Benny.
